# Flux Post-processing Chain

The fluxes are processed along the
[Swiss FluxNet flux processing chain](https://www.swissfluxnet.ethz.ch/index.php/data/ecosystem-fluxes/flux-processing-chain/).
EddyPro calculates the fluxes (Levels 0 and 1); the Python library
[diive](https://github.com/holukas/diive) runs the post-processing (Levels 2 to 4).

::: {.callout-note title="FP2026.1 and IRGA75"}
FP2026.1 contains the fluxes of the enclosed-path LI-7200 (`IRGA72`), 2016 to September 2026, up
to Level 4.1. The fluxes of the open-path LI-7500 (`IRGA75`, 2004 to 2017 and 2019) pass through
the additional self-heating correction of Level 1.1. They are in progress for FP2026.2 and are not
part of FP2026.1.
:::

## Flowchart

```{mermaid}
flowchart TB
    ecbin["EC raw data, binary"]
    bico["bico"]
    eccsv["EC raw data, ASCII"]
    met["meteo data"]
    EP["EddyPro, run with fluxrun"]
    L0F["L0: preliminary fluxes"]
    L1F["L1: final fluxes"]
    L11F["L1.1: self-heating correction (IRGA75 only, FP2026.2)"]

    subgraph diive_chain["diive post-processing chain"]
        L2QCF["L2: quality flags"]
        L31F["L3.1: storage term (NEE only)"]
        L32QCF["L3.2: outlier flags"]
        L33QCF["L3.3: USTAR flags (NEE only)"]
        QCF["overall quality flag QCF"]
        L41F["L4.1: gap-filling (XGBoost, MDS for comparison)"]
        L42F["L4.2: partitioning of NEE (not in FP2026.1)"]
    end

    ecbin --> bico --> eccsv --> EP
    EP --> L0F
    L0F -- "informs settings" --> L1F
    met -- "biomet input" --> L1F
    EP --> L1F
    L1F --> L11F
    L1F --> L2QCF
    L11F --> L2QCF
    L2QCF --> L31F --> L32QCF --> L33QCF --> QCF --> L41F --> L42F

    classDef orange fill:#FFE0B2,stroke:#E65100,stroke-width:2px,color:#E65100
    class L2QCF,L32QCF,L33QCF,QCF orange

    classDef green fill:#DCEDC8,stroke:#33691E,stroke-width:2px,color:#33691E
    class L0F,L1F,L11F,L31F,L41F,L42F green

    classDef blue fill:#E1F5FE,stroke:#01579B,stroke-width:2px,color:#01579B

    classDef white fill:#FFFFFF,stroke:#000000,stroke-width:2px,color:#000000

```

## Processing steps

| Step | What it does | In FP2026.1 |
|---|---|---|
| [Raw data](Raw_Data.md) | 20 Hz raw data, converted from binary to ASCII | not included |
| [Level 0](L0.md) | Preliminary flux calculation, to check the setup and choose the lag windows | not included |
| [Level 1](L1.md) | Final flux calculation with EddyPro, one run per setup period | yes |
| [Level 1.1](L1.1.md) | Self-heating correction of the open-path `IRGA75` | no, FP2026.2 |
| [Level 2](L2.md) | Quality flags from the EddyPro output | yes |
| [Level 3.1](L3.1.md) | Storage term added to `FC`, giving `NEE` | yes |
| [Level 3.2](L3.2.md) | Outlier flags | yes |
| [Level 3.3](L3.3.md) | USTAR flags at three constant thresholds (`NEE` only) | yes |
| [QCF](QCF.md) | Overall quality flag, combining the flags of all levels | yes |
| [Level 4.1](L4.1.md) | Gap-filling with XGBoost; MDS for comparison | yes |
| [Level 4.2](L4.2.md) | Partitioning of `NEE` into `GPP` and `RECO` | no |

: The processing steps and whether their output is part of FP2026.1. {#tbl-fpc-steps}

`LE` (with `ET`) and `H` pass through the same levels without a storage term and without a USTAR
filter, as in Pastorello et al. (2020). `H` uses only the quality flags of the sonic anemometer.
